_doc: CITED published baselines — NOT computed in this repo. Use verbatim with the source string.
_source: _research/gen_l3.py · 20 Newsgroups (sci.space, rec.sport.hockey), 8 shortest docs, deterministic (constants quoted from the cited papers below)

msmarco.source: Nguyen et al. 2016 (MS MARCO); BM25 ≈0.187 MRR@10 (official Anserini/pyserini); dense MS MARCO dev MRR@10 ≈0.33 from later DPR-style reproductions (RocketQA, Qu et al. 2021 / pyserini) — the original DPR paper (Karpukhin 2020) does not evaluate MS MARCO; ColBERT Khattab & Zaharia 2020

beir.source: Thakur et al. 2021 (BEIR), avg nDCG@10 over 18 zero-shot datasets: BM25 ≈0.43; original DPR (Karpukhin 2020 NQ checkpoint) only ≈0.23 (−47.7% vs BM25, the worst generalization in the paper); ColBERTv2 (Santhanam et al. 2022) ≈0.50 over its 13 reported BEIR sets
